question: 退款额最高的商品是什么
gold_sql: select p.product_name, sum(r.refund_amount) from refunds r join order_items oi on r.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id group by p.product_name order by sum(r.refund_amount) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_refund DESC
LIMIT 1;
pred_sql:
